verdict.rationale: Swell is an ecommerce platform, so abandoned-cart recovery is an applicable axis. The evidence pack never documents abandoned cart or checkout detection, nor any automated recovery email or link. Purchase links are merchant-configured checkout URLs rather than recovery flows, and webhooks, serverless functions and the Klaviyo SMS opt-in are building blocks or adjacent integrations, not a first-party recovery capability.

support.subject: As a merchant, abandoned carts and checkouts trigger recovery emails or links so I can win the sale back
